title: VPIN with volume buckets and bulk volume classification
source:
"""VPIN with volume-time buckets and bulk volume classification.

Bulk classification assigns each bar's volume to buyers in proportion
Phi(dp / sigma). Buckets are defined in VOLUME time, so the clean way to fill
them - including bars that straddle a boundary - is to work on cumulative
curves: cumulative volume C(i) and cumulative buy volume B(i) are piecewise
linear in each other because a bar's buy fraction is constant within the bar.
The buy volume of bucket k is then B at volume k*V minus B at (k-1)*V, found by
linear interpolation. That splits straddling bars exactly and proportionally,
with no per-bar loop and no rounding drift across 200 buckets.
"""
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import norm

INPUT = "/input/environment/data/bars.parquet"
OUT_DIR = "/app/output"
N_BUCKETS_DIVISOR = 200
WINDOW = 50


def main() -> None:
    bars = pd.read_parquet(INPUT).sort_values("bar_time").reset_index(drop=True)
    volume = bars["volume"].to_numpy(float)
    dp = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.diff(bars["close"].to_numpy(float))])
    sigma = float(np.std(dp[1:], ddof=1))
    buy = volume * norm.cdf(dp / sigma)

    cum_v = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(volume)])
    cum_b = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(buy)])
    V = cum_v[-1] / N_BUCKETS_DIVISOR
    n_full = int(np.floor(cum_v[-1] / V * (1 + 1e-9)))
    edges = np.arange(n_full + 1) * V
    edges[-1] = min(edges[-1], cum_v[-1])                   # float guard on the last edge

    bucket_buy = np.diff(np.interp(edges, cum_v, cum_b))
    bucket_sell = V - bucket_buy
    # The bar that completes bucket k is the first bar whose cumulative volume reaches k*V.
    closer = np.searchsorted(cum_v, edges[1:] * (1 - 1e-12), side="left") - 1
    closer = np.clip(closer, 0, len(bars) - 1)
    end_time = bars["bar_time"].to_numpy()[closer]

    oi = np.abs(bucket_buy - bucket_sell)
    vpin = np.convolve(oi, np.ones(WINDOW), mode="valid") / (WINDOW * V)
    assert ((vpin >= -1e-12) & (vpin <= 1 + 1e-12)).all()
    assert np.allclose(bucket_buy + bucket_sell, V)

    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame({"bucket_id": np.arange(1, n_full + 1), "buy_volume": bucket_buy,
                  "sell_volume": bucket_sell, "end_time": end_time}).to_csv(
        os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "buckets.csv"), index=False, float_format="%.17g")
    pd.DataFrame({"bucket_id": np.arange(WINDOW, n_full + 1), "vpin": vpin}).to_csv(
        os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "vpin.csv"), index=False, float_format="%.17g")
    print(f"{n_full} buckets, VPIN range {vpin.min():.3f}-{vpin.max():.3f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
